correctness.rationale: Exact proof: angular interpolation yields a_i^2-r_i^2 b_i^2=(2pi/T_i)^2 and monotone angular motion, while the normal variational equation and cosine-denominator integral yield log(mu_i) exactly. Every circle is hyperbolic since mu_i !=1. For any polynomial field with m such circular limit cycles, radial polynomial xP+yQ is a nonzero multiple of the product of circle equations and the quotient vanishes at the origin, forcing degree at least 2m. The construction visibly has degree exactly 2m. Ten cases verified via exact symbolic algebra plus quadrature and ODE integrations; no inference of infinity from finite tests.

value.rationale: The independent simultaneous programming of 2m natural numerical dynamical invariants at the algebraically sharp geometric degree is a nonroutine inverse limit-cycle realization question. In particular same-sign multipliers at m=2, forbidden under a common affine twist or positive rotation-equivariance without other cycles, are achieved while keeping exact prescribed circles and periods. The theorem is general and exposes the price of imposing no-extra-cycle constraints.
